summary_markdown:
The conversation covered data processing discrepancies, noting that new demographic data from a client (Kido) showed different age/gender distributions compared to old data. It was confirmed that the current calculation method is correct and the previous production result was flawed.

Later, discussions focused on reporting requirements for analytics: 
*   The forecasting model uses the same day of the week for prediction.
*   Concerns were raised regarding the feasibility of generating 30 separate tables per frame daily via API. Limitations exist concerning data volume and extraction complexity (e.g., extracting 30 different tables from a single frame).
*   A specific reporting requirement was outlined: calculating average impressions per minute, broken down by every demographic group (31 groups) across 24 variables.
decisions: The forecasting model uses the same day of the week for prediction.
action_items: Someone needs to clarify the exact reporting requirements and scope regarding the 30 tables/frame extraction.
Someone will write up detailed specifications on the required data metrics (average impressions per minute, 31 demographic groups, 24 variables) tomorrow.
